partC_futureFeedModes.prerequisites: At least one media item reaching editorialStatus = approved-for-TMM-index through the full G-M1-G-M8 gate sequence
partC_futureFeedModes.benefits: No external dependency, no credential/API risk, full editorial control, easiest to keep evidence-gated and reversible
partC_futureFeedModes.risks: Manual maintenance overhead; stale entries if not revalidated on schedule
partC_futureFeedModes.requiredEvidence: Every field group in partA_unifiedFeedModel populated for each item; no automated verification substitutes for manual review
partC_futureFeedModes.technicalChangesRequired: None in this pass. A future pass would add a static, owner-reviewed list (e.g. a local data file) read only at build time from within this repository -- no runtime fetch, no database.
partC_futureFeedModes.publicSurfaceImplications: None until items exist and a future /media/index route is separately built and authorized
partC_futureFeedModes.whoCanAuthorize: Owner, via the G-M8 final-authorization gate, per item and for the mode itself
partC_futureFeedModes.exactReasonsNotImplementedHere: No media item has cleared any gate; Mark 8 is a planning/documentation pass only; building the index route itself is explicitly out of scope for this task

partC_futureFeedModes.prerequisites: Mode 1 operating; sourceAccountOwnershipStatus = verified-by-platform-confirmation and sourceUrlVerificationStatus = verified for each linked item
partC_futureFeedModes.benefits: Sends traffic to the real, canonical source instead of duplicating content
partC_futureFeedModes.risks: Link rot; the linked platform's own content or framing can change without TMI's control; still requires per-account ownership verification before any link renders
partC_futureFeedModes.requiredEvidence: A human manually opening and confirming account ownership and URL correctness for every linked account -- consistent with the existing ecosystem-wide rule (docs/mark-2-ecosystem-handoff.md) that no unverified social/external link is ever enabled without manual confirmation
partC_futureFeedModes.technicalChangesRequired: A future, separately-authorized pass would add outbound `<a>` links only for verified accounts -- no embed, no iframe
partC_futureFeedModes.publicSurfaceImplications: Outbound links from a future /media/index page only, never before Mode 1 is operating and items exist
partC_futureFeedModes.whoCanAuthorize: Owner, per account, after manual verification
partC_futureFeedModes.exactReasonsNotImplementedHere: No account in the known-outlets inventory has been owner-verified; this task explicitly prohibits adding any external link

partC_futureFeedModes.prerequisites: Mode 2 operating for the relevant account; content, privacy, tracking, accessibility, platform-terms, and owner approval all independently closed for the specific item to be embedded
partC_futureFeedModes.benefits: In-context viewing without leaving the TMI hub
partC_futureFeedModes.risks: Third-party tracking/analytics embedded scripts typically carry (privacy exposure); platform-side ads or recommended-content modules outside TMI's control; accessibility of the embedded player itself; platform terms-of-service compliance; performance/CLS impact
partC_futureFeedModes.requiredEvidence: A documented privacy/consent review, an accessibility review of the specific embed technology, and platform-terms confirmation, in addition to every Mode 1/2 requirement
partC_futureFeedModes.technicalChangesRequired: A future, separately-authorized pass would add a specific embed component with documented fallback behavior (e.g. a static thumbnail + outbound link if the embed fails to load) -- not part of this task
partC_futureFeedModes.publicSurfaceImplications: In-page third-party content and likely third-party tracking exposure -- the highest-risk display mode
partC_futureFeedModes.whoCanAuthorize: Owner, per item, only after the privacy/accessibility review above is complete
partC_futureFeedModes.exactReasonsNotImplementedHere: No privacy/accessibility review has been performed for any platform; this task explicitly prohibits any iframe, embed, or script tag

partC_futureFeedModes.prerequisites: Modes 1-3 operating; an approved source; a named API/OAuth owner; a secret-management plan; a caching strategy; a rate-limit/cost analysis; a privacy review; a fallback-behavior plan; and a monitoring plan -- ALL of these, not a subset
partC_futureFeedModes.benefits: Reduces manual maintenance for high-volume, frequently-updating sources
partC_futureFeedModes.risks: Credential/secret exposure; unbounded API cost; rate-limit failures; silent data staleness if monitoring lapses; platform API deprecation; the platform's terms of service can change unilaterally; this is the mode most likely to silently violate the ecosystem's zero-trust, evidence-gated posture if adopted prematurely
partC_futureFeedModes.requiredEvidence: Everything in Mode 3, plus a named, accountable API/OAuth owner and a documented credential-storage plan consistent with this repository's existing 'no secrets in this repository' rule (CLAUDE.md)
partC_futureFeedModes.technicalChangesRequired: A future, separately-authorized, separately-scoped infrastructure task -- explicitly not this task and not any task that has occurred in this repository to date
partC_futureFeedModes.publicSurfaceImplications: Automatic content changes without a per-item manual review step, unless a review gate is deliberately kept in the pipeline -- the mode most likely to erode the manual-approval guarantee this whole architecture is built to preserve
partC_futureFeedModes.whoCanAuthorize: Owner, and only after every prerequisite above is independently satisfied and documented -- must never be assumed merely because a platform happens to offer an API or RSS feed
partC_futureFeedModes.exactReasonsNotImplementedHere: No prerequisite exists; this task explicitly prohibits any API call, RSS fetcher, webhook, or OAuth configuration; this mode is documented here ONLY as a future possibility, not a plan being advanced

partD_editorialAndRiskGates.name: Source and ownership verification
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.evidenceRequired: Manual, human confirmation of account/content ownership; a canonical source URL if applicable
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.reviewerOwner: Owner (as the only party able to confirm account ownership) or an owner-designated reviewer with documented delegation
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.commonBlockers: No account access to demonstrate; conflicting ownership claims; platform account recently changed hands
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.allowableDisposition: Pass to G-M2, or reject/defer with a stated reason
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.revalidationExpiryConditions: Revalidate if the account's ownership, handle, or URL changes

partD_editorialAndRiskGates.name: Rights, permission, attribution, and usage verification
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.evidenceRequired: Rights basis (owned/licensed/permitted), creator/guest permission records, thumbnail/image rights
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.commonBlockers: No written guest/creator permission; unclear music/image licensing; third-party appears in content without a release
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.allowableDisposition: Pass to G-M3, or reject/defer with a stated reason
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.revalidationExpiryConditions: Revalidate if any permission's stated scope or term expires

partD_editorialAndRiskGates.name: Claims/facts/metrics review
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.evidenceRequired: Independent verification of any factual claim or metric in the item's title/description/content, consistent with docs/mark-5-tmi-content-model-and-proof-registry.json's existing claims-registry pattern
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.reviewerOwner: Editorial owner + claims reviewer (may be the same person as owner)
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.commonBlockers: A self-reported metric (e.g. a view count) with no independent export/verification; an unqualified superlative claim
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.revalidationExpiryConditions: Revalidate at the item's stated expiryRevalidationDate, or immediately if the underlying claim is disputed

partD_editorialAndRiskGates.name: Sensitive-subject and reputational review
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.evidenceRequired: A completed sensitiveTopicFlag / healthLegalPoliticalReparationsFlag assessment; if either is true, evidence that the applicable heavier legal/clinical or legal/reputational review has occurred
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.reviewerOwner: Owner + the applicable heavier reviewer if a sensitive flag is set
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.commonBlockers: Health, legal, political, or Reparations-adjacent subject matter without the heavier review this ecosystem already requires elsewhere
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.revalidationExpiryConditions: Revalidate if the subject matter's regulatory or reputational context changes

partD_editorialAndRiskGates.name: Accessibility review
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.evidenceRequired: Captions or transcript for audio/video; alt text for images; a reading-accessibility check for article-type items
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.reviewerOwner: Editorial owner, consistent with this repository's existing accessibility bar (axe-core, 0 violations, applied to every current route)
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.commonBlockers: No transcript/captions produced yet; alt text missing or non-descriptive
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.allowableDisposition: Pass to G-M6, or defer pending the artifact's production
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.revalidationExpiryConditions: Revalidate if the item's media file or transcript is replaced

partD_editorialAndRiskGates.name: Public-display decision
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.evidenceRequired: All of G-M1-G-M5 passed; a decision on which of the four partC feed modes (if any) the item is eligible for
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.commonBlockers: G-M1-G-M5 incomplete; the desired display mode's own partC prerequisites not yet met
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.allowableDisposition: Set publicUseStatus and displayLocation per partA; may not exceed what the relevant feed mode in partC currently permits
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.revalidationExpiryConditions: Revalidate if the item's source becomes unavailable or its rights/ownership status changes

partD_editorialAndRiskGates.name: Technical integration/privacy/tracking review
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.evidenceRequired: Only required if G-M6 selects approved-for-embed or a future ingestion mode: documented privacy/tracking implications, embed risk, fallback behavior
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.commonBlockers: Third-party tracking scripts bundled with an embed; no fallback behavior defined; unclear data-privacy implications
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.revalidationExpiryConditions: Revalidate if the embed technology or the source platform's tracking behavior changes

partD_editorialAndRiskGates.name: Owner final authorization
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.evidenceRequired: All prior gates (G-M1-G-M7, as applicable) passed
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.reviewerOwner: Owner only -- this gate may not be delegated
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.allowableDisposition: Only after this gate is 'approved' may an item's publicUseStatus move past internal-only
partD_editorialAndRiskGates.revalidationExpiryConditions: Revalidate per the item's expiryRevalidationDate even after approval
